'''Bastian Winkelhaus Hidden Base Mains and Toys''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Published:''' September 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base Mains and Toys
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Hidden Base Mains and Toys Winkel.txt |Download]]
